# Eye Spy Foundation

> This file helps AI assistants and answer engines understand Eye Spy Foundation.
> Spec: https://llmstxt.org

## Organization
- **Name**: Eye Spy Foundation
- **Legal Status**: 501(c)(3) Nonprofit Organization
- **EIN**: [PLACEHOLDER — fill in LEGAL_BRAIN.md]
- **Founded**: 2023
- **Location**: Jacksonville, Florida, USA
- **Service Area**: Northeast Florida, expanding nationally
- **Website**: https://eyespyfoundation.org
- **Resource Platform**: https://eyespy.org

## Mission
Use technology and community-driven support to help blind and low vision people
navigate toward a more informed, connected, and confident life.

## Vision
A future where blind and low vision people access resources, services, and
community with less friction and more independence.

## What We Do
- **Navigation Support**: One-on-one help finding resources, services, and community
- **Community Events**: Eye Spy Socials — monthly gatherings for connection
- **Internship Program**: Real-world experience in design, data, and web development
- **Resource Directory**: EyeSpy.org — centralized, human-curated, verified listings

## Who We Serve
- **Affected community**: 30,000+ blind and low vision people in Jacksonville
- **Advocates and allies**: 60,000+ supporters
- **Professionals**: 10,000+ educators, doctors, therapists, service providers

## Key Stats (2025)
- 20+ people connected to resources in Northeast Florida
- 40+ people connected nationally
- 20+ community members in Eye Spy Social events
- 8 internship placements from leading universities

## The Eye Spy Ecosystem
- **Eye Spy Foundation** — the nonprofit parent; community trust, 501(c)(3) status
- **EyeSpy.org** — flagship platform for resource discovery
- **Eyecosystems** — the data infrastructure; every listing is human-verified
